Nia: quick follow-up from the postmortem board about the throughput spike and SLO actions. TL;DR: add per-tenant throughput soft-SLOs, a short SLO-champion rotation, and an error-budget banking rule.
Ethan: can you define "error-budget banking" here?
Nia: banking = allow borrowing error budget from non-critical tenants for short windows to avoid cascading autoscale; must be repaid within 6h or triggers rollback.
Rae: hmm risky. how do we enforce repayment?
Nia: automated job: if borrowed > 5% of total error budget, schedule a hard rollback to conservative routing and page on repayment miss.
Ethan: paste the repayment alert?
Nia: short alert rule:
```
ALERT ErrorBudget_Borrow_Missed
IF sum(borrowed_error_budget_total) > 0 AND time() - last_repayment_time > 21600
FOR 5m
LABELS {severity="page"}
```
Rae: who owns implementing the bank + rotation?
Nia: propose rotation: 1 week SLO-champion. Week A = Nia (draft dashboards + bank logic), Week B = Ethan (tests + runbook). Nia fallback.
Ethan: timeline?
Nia: dashboard + bank prototype due 2167893600, alert + repayment job due 2167897200, runbook + rotation calendar due 2167900800.
infra-bot: Incident #5012 closed - root cause: bursty tenant traffic -> worker saturation -> KV cache drops.
Rae: external comms? ops prefers internal unless >1% customers impacted.
Ethan: I'll add a note to support playbook about thresholds.
Nia: thanks. we'll re-evaluate tightening p99 back once two clean repayment windows passed. check-in Friday 09:00. :white_check_mark:
